notes.title: Global Release Timing For “SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance”
notes.notes: [p]The release date of SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance is fast approaching on August 29th! Get prepared by knowing the release [b]time[/b] in your region.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/d0d55991f61f1007036bd1ac46f1ca984fbac21c.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]And don't forget:[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]①Don't want to wait until August 29th? Pre-order the Digital Deluxe Edition to [u]play three days early![/u][/b][/h3][p]Also receive the Starter Pack, Digital Art Book & Soundtrack, and SEGA Villains Stage [b]DLC[/b], featuring Dr. Eggman and 2 guest bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1225326/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]②Pre-order and [u]save 10%[/u] [/b][/h3][p]In addition, as a pre-order bonus, you will receive  the Original Arcade Outfit and Fortune Hunter Amulet.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]③[u]Free Demo[/u] available now![/b][/h3][p]Play an enhanced version of the first stage, Oboro Village.  Enjoy a thrilling challenge with enhanced ninja abilities, greater enemy variety, unlocked hidden paths and a modified shop system. Once you've conquered the stage, push your skills further by replaying it in Arcade Mode and aim for the highest score.[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489510/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]
